info.name: Nathmandir — Lyrics & Audio Access (Modified APIs)
info.description:
Contains ONLY the two existing Mobile APIs that were modified to implement the Lyrics/Audio access rule:

  • Unpaid User  → lyrics returned, audioUrl = null, locked = true
  • Paid User    → lyrics returned, audioUrl = full URL, locked = false

No new APIs were created. These are existing apicall handlers inside POST /api/mobile.

variable.description: Backend base URL. Change to your production URL when deploying.
JWT for a paid user (has rows in user_access table). Obtain via apicall=verifyOTP.
JWT for an unpaid user (no rows in user_access table). Obtain via apicall=verifyOTP.

item.name: 1. get_content — Content list with Lyrics + Audio gating
item.description:
Returns the published song list for a module.

Lyrics rule (implemented in get_content function, mobile.controller.js):
  - lyrics field: ALWAYS returned regardless of subscription
  - audioUrl field: returned only when user owns the module; null otherwise
  - locked field: true = unpaid, false = paid

This folder contains two example requests — one for each user type.

item.name: get_content — UNPAID USER (locked=true, audioUrl=null, lyrics visible)

header.description: JWT for a user who has NOT purchased this module

query.description: Existing apicall value — not a new API

request.description:
Calls the existing get_content handler for an unpaid user.

Expected behavior:
  - owned: false
  - locked: true  (on every content item)
  - audioUrl: null  (audio is blocked)
  - lyrics: returned as a non-empty string (FREE to all logged-in users)

The app uses 'locked' to show/hide the audio player button.
The app uses 'lyrics' to display the text — always visible.

item.name: get_content — PAID USER (locked=false, audioUrl=URL, lyrics visible)

header.description: JWT for a user who HAS purchased this module (has a row in user_access)

query.description: Existing apicall value — not a new API

request.description:
Calls the existing get_content handler for a paid user.

Expected behavior:
  - owned: true
  - locked: false  (on every content item)
  - audioUrl: full URL to the audio file
  - lyrics: returned as a non-empty string

Both lyrics AND audio are accessible for a paid user.

item.name: 2. get_media — Single item Lyrics + Audio gating
item.description:
Called when the user taps a single song. Returns lyrics and optionally the audio URL.

Lyrics rule (implemented in get_media function, mobile.controller.js):
  - lyrics field: ALWAYS returned regardless of subscription
  - audioUrl field: returned only when user owns the module; null otherwise
  - locked field: true = unpaid, false = paid

This folder contains two example requests — one for each user type.

item.name: get_media — UNPAID USER (locked=true, audioUrl=null, lyrics visible)

header.description: JWT for a user who has NOT purchased the module this content belongs to

query.description: Existing apicall value — not a new API

request.description:
Calls the existing get_media handler for an unpaid user.

'id' is the content item ID (integer). The server looks up which product this
item belongs to and checks user_access for ownership.

Expected behavior:
  - locked: true
  - audioUrl: null  (audio is blocked)
  - lyrics: returned (free to all logged-in users)

Content id=14 belongs to product 'upasana'.
This user has no row in user_access for 'upasana', so audio is blocked.

response.name: Unpaid User — lyrics visible, audio locked

item.name: get_media — PAID USER (locked=false, audioUrl=URL, lyrics visible)

header.description: JWT for a user who HAS purchased the module this content belongs to

query.description: Existing apicall value — not a new API

request.description:
Calls the existing get_media handler for a paid user.

'id' is the content item ID (integer). The server looks up which product this
item belongs to and checks user_access for ownership.

Expected behavior:
  - locked: false
  - audioUrl: full URL to the audio file
  - lyrics: returned

Content id=14 belongs to product 'upasana'.
This user has a row in user_access for 'upasana' (source=purchased, expiresOn=null),
so both lyrics and audio are returned.

response.name: Paid User — lyrics visible + audio unlocked
